title: SignalCubeCriticalPathRow
description: Per-window critical-path statistics of one service over CP-eligible traces, including the slow-trace spectrum used by Causatrix's cp_sbfl (03 §3.4). Written by Signalyth; depends on alert windows.

window.description: Alert window the traces are assigned to (by the primary root's start_ns).

service.description: Service; rows exist only for services seen in eligible traces of the window.

traces.description: Eligible traces in the window where the service's critical-path self time is > 0.

cp_self_ms_p50.description: Median critical-path self time (ms) over those traces; 0.0 when traces = 0.

cp_self_ms_p99.description: p99 critical-path self time (ms) over those traces; 0.0 when traces = 0.

cp_share_mean.description: Σ over eligible traces of (service CP self / root duration) ÷ traces_total (absent traces count as 0); in [0, 1].

traces_total.description: Eligible traces in the window after the cap cp.max_traces_per_window; same value on every row of the window.

traces_slow.description: Slow eligible traces (root duration above the baseline p95 of its entry operation) on which the service's critical-path self time is > 0.

cp_share_sum_slow.description: Σ over those slow traces of (service CP self / root duration); spectrum numerator for cp_sbfl.
